name: Drovane Chamber 6 Original
description: This listing is a haboob-rated observation mast listed with platform height 8 metres, field of view 259 degrees, occupancy 13 people. Its remaining stated figures are session length 4 hours, per person set after acceptance, transit mode specialist vehicle. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
